actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog1
actions.subtitle: You may habe defeated me, but you're too late to stop Dr. Octavius.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog3
actions.subtitle: You won't catch him, Spider-Man.  His plan is already underway, and you were wasting your time with me when you should have been catching the train.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog4
actions.subtitle: Real cute, Fishbowl.  I take it he's at the train station.  (to himself)  I can still make it.

actions.name: ACTION_Say4
actions.subtitle: A big Mysterio statue?  That's gotta go.

actions.name: ACTION_Say2
actions.subtitle: Here's a new little surprise for you, Spider-Man.

actions.name: ACTION_Say0
actions.subtitle: This time, I'll deal with you myself.

actions.name: ACTION_Say3
actions.subtitle: This is my ultimate weapon.  You're embarrassingly outgunned.  Give up now and I may show you some mercy.

actions.name: ACTION_Say1
actions.subtitle: Spider-Man!  I don't know how you made it this far, but it's time to get serious about this city's pest problem.

actions.name: ACTION_Say8
actions.subtitle: Think you're winning, Spider-Man?  Well, think again.

actions.name: ACTION_Say5
actions.subtitle: Now I have you right where I want you!

actions.name: ACTION_Say7
actions.subtitle: I don't know how you made it this far, Spider-Man, but you'll go no further.
